report.summary: Checked out the asset '{{v1}}' (E2E-00001) to user 'E2E Assignee' with note '{{v3}}'. On the checkout form the user was committed via the select2 dropdown ("E2E Assignee (e2e-assignee)" chip rendered, list closed), the note '{{v3}}' was typed and read back from the Notes textarea, and clicking the Checkout button produced the success alert "Asset checked out successfully." Navigating to the asset page (http://127.0.0.1:8000/hardware/1) confirms the checkout: the checked-out-to block now shows the link "E2E Assignee" with status "Deployed", "Last Checkout 2026-10-26 … ago", and Expected Checkin N/A. Screenshot saved (asset_checked_out.png).
